cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The table can float while we pack. That wet cup needs a mat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's at the ceiling. I'll pull it down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait! You'll slide the cup across the polish. Get the stepladder; I'll hold it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll climb onto the table. My boots are muddy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Boots off! I'll hold them. Dry socks only on that polish.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 permits levitation, A3 objects to polish damage and offers ladder support, then A5 takes boots while insisting on clean socks rather than worrying about height.
